body:
# 这是一个无政府硬核SMP服务器（需要正版）
玩家死亡后会被封禁15分钟，封禁后可以被其他玩家使用不死图腾解封
同时玩家被击杀后会掉落该玩家的头颅，头颅可以和金块一起合成不死图腾
世界边界为半径50万，服务器禁用水晶与重生锚（可以合成使用，但无爆炸伤害）
## 服务器公告qq群：689682721


 服务器规则:1.禁止使用任何类型的外挂与作弊模组，服务器有专门的反作弊与巡查人员
            2.服务器内禁止人身攻击，开盒等恶劣行为



简介：欢迎来到我的世界 HardcoreSMP！主打无政府硬核生存，感受死亡封禁的刺激感，却让你的生存体验永不落幕，在这里，每一步探索都心跳拉满，每一次存活都值得珍惜！
我们的硬核核心规则超有料 —— 死亡即触发临时封禁，完美还原高紧张的生存氛围，让你挖矿、探索、遭遇对抗时不敢有半分松懈；但封禁从不是终点，你完全可以通过游戏内正常获取的物品完成解封，不靠氪金、不要求人，用自己的游戏成果解锁复活，心惊肉跳的同时，稳稳保住持续的游戏体验！
在 HardcoreSMP，我们奉行纯粹的无政府主义，没有条条框框束缚你的生存选择：你可以独闯四方建隐秘基地，也可以组队结盟掠夺资源，生存方式全由你定！同时我们守住公平底线 —— 允许矿透辅助探索，告别枯燥挖矿的低效时光；严禁一切 PVP 类外挂，杜绝恶意偷袭、数值碾压的不公，所有对抗回归真实操作与策略博弈，拼的是实力而非科技！
更重要的是，HardcoreSMP 无任何神权小团体，服务器内人人平等，没有特权玩家搞特殊！管理员全程不介入游戏内任何事务，不偏袒、不干预，只负责社群日常管理与问题处理，从根源上杜绝特权操作，让你凭真本事在这片大陆站稳脚跟！
这是属于硬核玩家的无政府生存天地，死亡有代价，复活有路径，公平无特权！



Server Type: Anarchy Hardcore SMP 
Core Mechanic: Death results in a 15-minute ban. Banned players can be unbanned by other players using a Totem of Undying.
Drop System: Players drop their own head upon death. Heads can be combined with gold blocks to craft Totems of Undying.
World Border: 500,000 block radius
Restrictions: End crystals and Respawn Anchors are disabled (can be crafted/placed, but deal zero explosion damage)
QQ Group: 689682721
Rules:
Zero Tolerance Policy: Any form of hacked clients or cheating mods is strictly prohibited. The server runs dedicated anti-cheat systems with active moderation staff.
Respect the Community: Harassment, doxxing, or any toxic behavior will result in immediate permanent bans.
Welcome to HardcoreSMP!
Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush of anarchic hardcore survival—where death carries real consequences, yet your journey never truly ends. Every step into the unknown keeps your heart racing; every moment of survival feels earned.
Our Signature Hardcore System:
Death triggers a temporary ban, delivering that high-stakes tension you crave—mining, exploring, and PvP encounters will keep you on edge. But a ban is never the end. You can earn your revival through in-game items obtainable by normal gameplay. No pay-to-win, no begging—just your own skill and determination unlocking your return. Heart-pounding stakes, guaranteed continuity.
True Anarchy, True Freedom:
HardcoreSMP embraces pure anarchism with no arbitrary restrictions holding you back. Build a hidden solo fortress deep underground, or form alliances to dominate the server—your survival strategy is entirely your choice. We maintain fair play through balanced exceptions: X-ray is permitted to streamline tedious mining, while all PVP-related cheats are strictly banned. No unfair ambushes, no stat manipulation—every fight comes down to genuine skill and strategy.
No Gods, No Masters:
HardcoreSMP has zero admin cliques or privileged players. Everyone is equal. Administrators never interfere with in-game affairs—no favoritism, no intervention. They handle only community management and technical issues, ensuring a completely level playing field where only merit determines success.
This is hardcore anarchy survival done right: death has a price, revival has a path, and fairness has no exceptions.
